abstract_research_topics.justification: General value functions are theoretical constructs in reinforcement learning that help in understanding how to assign value to different states and actions, which is a fundamental abstract concept in machine learning.
Value estimation is an abstract concept in deep learning and reinforcement learning, focusing on the theoretical methodologies for estimating the expected returns of different actions or policies.

Long-term autonomy involves theoretical research into creating systems that can function without humans for extended periods, which includes abstract concepts related to planning, decision-making, and sustainability.

Self-supervised learning is a theoretical research topic that focuses on how models can learn representations of the data without using explicit labels, which is an abstract area of study that informs a wide range of applications.

application_domains.justification: These domains involve practical applications of AI for psychological assessment and intervention in social settings, focusing on the real-world interaction of AI with human emotions and behaviors.
This domain involves applying AI to diagnose and treat psychological disorders, focusing on real-world implementations in healthcare settings.
This domain applies AI to understand the physiological underpinnings of behavior, often used in practical applications such as biofeedback and neurotechnology.

In this domain, AI is applied to comprehend and generate human-like creativity, intentions, and emotions, focusing on developing practical applications that interact with human cognitive and emotional processes.
Mindfulness AI applications involve practical systems designed to promote mental well-being, such as stress reduction apps and cognitive-behavioral therapy tools.
Although abstract in thought, AI applications in the philosophy of mind often involve practical conceptual tools for exploring consciousness and cognitive processes computationally.
AI in the theory of mind looks at practical applications where machines understand and predict human thoughts and emotions, crucial for real-world predictive and interactive technologies.
This involves the practical use of AI technologies to assist in medical diagnostics, treatment planning, and patient monitoring.

The application of AI to generate art, music, and other creative content, focusing on real-world applications that mimic human creative processes.
This domain focuses on the practical integration of AI in mobile devices, improving functionality and user interactions.
Practical applications of AI in educational settings to enhance learning experiences, personalized education, and administrative functions.
AI applications directed towards social good and improving human conditions, stressing real-world benefits of AI technology.
This involves the practical design of AI systems that prioritize human needs, usability, and interaction, enhancing the human-AI user experience.
Despite its philosophical roots, AI consciousness involves practical approaches to developing AI systems that mimic human consciousness in specific applications or settings.
This involves the application of AI in ways that are ethically and socially responsible, focusing on the real-world impact and governance of AI technologies.
